        <p>I analyze whether the benefits of place-based investments reach the households and neighborhoods that need them most, or whether market responses concentrate gains among already-advantaged groups.</p>

      <div class="snapshot-card">
        <h3>Urban Informatics &amp; Spatial Data Science</h3>

<section class="project-section">

      </h3>
      <p class="project-tagline">
        Housing Capitalization, Spatial Spillovers, and Distributional Effects

      </p>
      <p class="project-description">
        This project examines whether flood-mitigation investments are capitalized
        into nearby housing values, how far their effects extend across space, and
